newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks move up one percent in the week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks move up one percent in the week.

text.p: Bahraini shares rose one percent in the holiday-shortened week to Thursday, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
It said the index rose to 1,571.09 points from 1,554.99 points the previous week in trade shortened to four days, due to the Eid al-Adha holiday.
Around 6.6 million shares worth 1.37 million dinars ($3.6 million) were traded, down from 7.83 million shares worth 1.78 million dinars the previous week.
Shares of 20 of the 39 firms registered in the exchange were traded in 215 transactions, the bourse said.

It said 2.1 million Bahrain Middle East Bank shares worth 208,259 dinars changed hands. The share closed on Thursday at 98 fils. Some 832,000 Al-Ahli Commercial Bank shares worth 283,960 dinars were dealt. It ended at 338 fils.
Bahrain's bouse is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Oman and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
